job_description: Prepare, implement, and monitor the Contractor's Site-Specific Environmental Management Plan (CSEMP) in full compliance with NESCO, ADB SPS 2009, and IFC EHS Guidelines. Supervise environmental compliance during high-impact construction activities including sand filling, excavation, dismantling of old gantry steel structures and concrete bases, and heavy equipment installation. Oversee specialized environmental SOPs, including SF6 gas management and leak monitoring for 33 kV GIS, hazardous waste and transformer oil spill prevention, and water drainage/siltation control (ensuring <= 50 mg/L TSS discharge). Conduct regular site inspections, internal environmental audits, and prepare monthly EMP Implementation Compliance Reports for NESCO, PMU, and PIAC. Coordinate community consultation, Grievance Redress Mechanism (GRM) logging, and post-construction site rehabilitation, soil leveling, and revegetation programs. Assist in preparing and updating site-specific HSE plans, risk assessments, and JSAs for fabrication and erection activities. Conduct daily site and workshop inspections, record findings, and follow up until corrective actions are closed. Monitor the issuing and closure of Permits to Work for hot work, lifting, and work at height, and ensure they are displayed and enforced. Carry out toolbox talks and safety briefings for welders, fitters, riggers, and erection crews before each shift. Verify PPE use, machine guarding, housekeeping, and fire safety arrangements at workshops and client sites. Support contractor and subcontractor safety, including safety induction and checking of crew competency records. Assist in incident reporting, near-miss recording, and preliminary investigation, and share findings with the Head of HSE. Maintain HSE records, registers, training matrices, and inspection logs in line with ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 requirements. Coordinate with production and project supervisors to ensure HSE requirements are built into daily work schedules. Participate in emergency drills and support the implementation of the emergency response plan at fabrication and client sites. Enforce Occupational Health & Safety (OHS) standards aligned with ISO 45001, Bangladesh Labor Act (2006, amended), ADB SPS 2009, and IFC EHS Guidelines for Electric Power Transmission & Distribution. Manage Permit-to-Work (PTW) and Lock-Out/Tag-Out (LOTO) electrical isolation protocols when working adjacent to live 33 kV / 132 kV overhead lines and energized substation bays. Supervise high-risk site operations: working at heights and fall prevention, heavy crane lifting/GIS panel rigging, deep trenching/piling, and dismantling of existing gantry structures. Enforce zero-tolerance PPE compliance, site perimeter barricading/signage, traffic and flagmen control, and labor camp welfare standards (separate male/female sanitation, potable water, first aid, and fire-fighting points). Lead daily toolbox talks, worker safety awareness workshops, emergency evacuation drills, communicable disease prevention programs, and incident/near-miss reporting.

job_description: Medical Officer - Indoor, Emergency & ICU/NICU  1. Indoor Medical Officer (IMO)  - Inpatient monitoring:  Assess admitted patients, track vital signs and progress, and provide follow-up care (including post-operative care).  Treatment & emergencies:  Carry out consultant orders, order diagnostic tests, and respond to urgent or sudden changes in inpatient conditions.  Coordination & records:  Update consultants on patient status, maintain accurate medical records or electronic health entries, and hand over care cleanly at shift changes.  2. Emergency Medical Officer (EMO)  - Triage and assessment:  Rapidly evaluate incoming patients, take medical histories, and prioritize urgent or life-threatening cases. Resuscitation and stabilization:  Perform life-saving interventions, manage trauma or acute medical/surgical emergencies, and stabilize patients. Diagnostics and treatment:  Order and interpret urgent tests, prescribe medications, and carry out emergency procedures. Coordination and referrals:  Work with nurses, specialists, surgeons, and emergency teams to admit, transfer, or refer patients. Documentation:  Maintain accurate medical records, case sheets, and treatment reports.  3. ICU Medical Officer  - Continuous monitoring & stabilization:  Assess critically ill patients, interpret diagnostics (such as blood gases and hemodynamic data), and manage acute conditions like sepsis, respiratory failure, and multi-organ organ dysfunction.  Life support & procedures:  Assist with or perform airway management/intubation, mechanical ventilation, resuscitation, central venous or dialysis catheterization, and intercostal drainage. Team coordination & family communication:  Work under senior ICU specialists/intensivists alongside nurses and support staff, conduct rounds, and counsel patients' families. 4. NICU Medical Officer  - Assessment & Monitoring:  Performing physical exams on newborns, tracking vital signs and clinical progress, and adjusting treatment plans as needed.  Emergency & Resuscitation:  Responding rapidly to acute changes in a baby's condition and performing neonatal resuscitation and stabilization.  Respiratory & Life Support:  Managing oxygen therapy, neonatal ventilation, and other life-support measures.  Neonatal Procedures:  Performing procedures such as endotracheal (ET) intubation, umbilical catheterization, or arterial/central line insertion as trained and qualified.  Routine Critical Care:  Managing newborn sepsis and infection control, thermoregulation, feeding/nutrition support, and jaundice/phototherapy care.  Family & Team Communication:  Updating and counseling parents/attendants and coordinating with consultants and nursing staff.
skills_required: Clinical Assessment and Diagnostic, Decision making capabilities, Documentation and Reporting, Emergency patient management, ICU Patient treatment, NICU PICU, Primary Care

Stakeholder Coordination:  Maintain strong relationships with local farmers, agricultural extension officers (DAE), and community leaders to ensure smooth project execution.
